integrity: A proof is included for every all-dimensional statement. Exact finite checks corroborate, but cannot replace, the proof. General published circumradius formulas are credited. No claim of historical uniqueness is certified.
scientific_limitations: Arbitrary strictly positive weights in an intrinsic Euclidean hyperplane; no zero-weight degenerations. Scalar zonotope radius representations are established prior work. The new contribution under assessment is the full weighted incenter-locus and contact classification. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Weighted simplex-generator zonotopes: an exact incenter graph and discrepancy-controlled outer contacts
